view: Paquime Casas Grandes low oblique view among warm tan poured-earth adobe room walls with softly rounded eroded tops, one surviving characteristic T-shaped doorway clearly shaped wider at top narrow below, small courts and low hills beyond, no stone Maya pyramids or reconstructed multistorey apartments.

eras.title: Rooms shaped from earth
eras.caption: Paquimé's rounded earthen walls enclose rooms, passages and small courts. The surviving lower storeys preserve the plan of a settlement that connected the communities of northern Mexico with the Pueblo world farther north.
